---
title: "Baby Names Analysis"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data
files <- list.files("data", pattern = "^yob.*\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

baby_names <- read_csv(
  files,
  id = "file",
  col_names = c("name", "sex", "n"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(year = parse_number(basename(file)))
```

Over the last 100 years, the popularity of the name **David** surged during the post-World War II baby boom, peaking in 1955 with over 86,000 babies. Since the 1960s, its popularity has experienced a long, steady decline.

```{r}
#| label: plot-david
baby_names |>
  filter(name == "David", year >= max(year) - 100) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarize(total = sum(n)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = total)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Popularity of the Name 'David' Over the Last 100 Years",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Babies"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

At its peak in the mid-1950s, more than 2% of all registered baby names in the United States were David.

```{r}
#| label: plot-david-percent
baby_names |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarize(pct_david = sum(n[name == "David"]) / sum(n)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = pct_david)) +
  geom_line(color = "darkred", linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 0.5)) +
  labs(
    title = "Percentage of All Baby Names That Are 'David'",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Percentage of All Babies"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
